title: Keep 2TB of files in an encrypted cloud for $150
excerpt: A cloud storage plan with some serious privacy credentials.
content_html:
TL;DR: Drime’s 2TB lifetime cloud storage plan is 50% off at $149.97 (reg. $299) through Sept. 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT, with EU hosting, end-to-end encryption and collaboration tools.

Credit: Drime

$149.97
$299 Save $149.03

Cloud storage makes backing up and sharing files a piece of cake, but not every provider gives you control over where your data is stored or how it’s shared. Drime’s Essentials plan offers 2TB of storage on an EU-based cloud, combining robust privacy with streamlined collaboration tools. For a limited time, the Drime Secure Cloud Storage: Lifetime Subscription is 50% off at $149.97 (reg. $299) until Sept. 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

One impressive feature is Drime’s encrypted Vault, which uses locally applied encryption alongside 256-bit AES and SSL/TLS protection. Drime says files stored there are encrypted in a way that prevents even the company itself from accessing their contents. Files are hosted in Europe, and the service is GDPR-compliant, with data not routed through U.S. servers.

There’s no cap on file size for uploads, handy if you’re working with multi-gigabyte videos rather than just Word docs. You can also revert files to previous versions for up to 120 days, so accidental overwrites don’t mean it’s the end of the world.

Drime treats cloud storage as a team workspace. You can create shared folders for up to 15 people, edit documents together, add timestamped comments to videos and PDFs, and collect e-signatures with Drime Sign. Sharing links can be protected with passwords, custom URLs, and expiration dates, and you can monitor who accesses your files.

This plan is valuable for small teams, photographers, videographers, or anyone who routinely exchanges large project files. Files sync seamlessly across desktop and mobile, and collaborators can access only what you share.

The Essentials plan even includes advanced admin features, like role-based permissions and centralized controls, typically reserved for Drime’s Professional tier. For individuals and small teams looking for secure storage plus sharing, Essentials brings a broad suite of tools in one place.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

If you want cloud storage that goes beyond basic file syncing, Drime’s 2TB lifetime plan is available for $149.97 (reg. $299) until Sept. 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
